item.title: Rive
item.description: Realistic, interactive UIs https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=85mR4qEQ-aU https://designcourse.com/greenthumb Framer Figma Midjourney Illustrator Photoshop ClaudeAI UnicornStudio Rive Identity Design Process: Begin by crafting a combination logo and selecting colors for the project. This step is informed by a fictional brief generated by Claude AI. Figma UI/UX Process: Design the landing page UI in Figma after completing the identity design phase. Framer & Rive Process: Transition to using Framer and Rive to develop a functional product in the browser once the UI/UX is finalized. Unicorn Studio: Optionally explore the no-code WebGL editor, Unicorn Studio, to enhance the project. こんな GUI 版 Git ツールのキャラクタのリグがRive だった
